postman.com.company_overview: Postman is an API platform for building and using APIs. Postman simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration so that you can create better APIs—faster.
postman.com.target_audience: Individuals, teams, and enterprises building and using APIs

supabase.com.company_overview: Supabase is an open‑source platform that offers a fully managed Postgres backend, serving as a Firebase alternative for developers. It is backed by major investors and supports a global community of over 10 million developers.
supabase.com.target_audience: Developers, startups, enterprises, AI builders, and innovation teams

vapi.ai.company_overview: Vapi is a voice AI platform that offers usage-based and enterprise pricing for call, SMS, and chat services, with features such as custom voices, HIPAA compliance, and zero data retention.
vapi.ai.target_audience: Developers and enterprises seeking scalable voice AI solutions.
